caption:
Large Sahab Disapproves, No. 03. Five new crimes. Zero forgiveness, as usual. 🥃

Which one have you committed? Confess below. Large Sahab already knows.

Tag the friend who tops up your glass without asking.

Water between pegs. Never drink and drive.

#LargeSahab #EkLarge #WhiskyLovers #DesiHumour

scenes.label: CRIME No. 1
scenes.title: Storing the bottle on its side.
scenes.body: Whisky stands upright. Strong spirit is hard on the cork.

scenes.label: CRIME No. 3
scenes.title: Sniffing whisky like a bloodhound.
scenes.body: Gently, beta. It’s about 40% alcohol, not perfume.

scenes.label: CRIME No. 4
scenes.title: Finishing the last peg “so it’s not wasted.”
scenes.body: The bottle will wait. Your liver is not a dustbin.

scenes.label: CRIME No. 5
scenes.title: Pushing a friend who said no.
scenes.body: No means no. Get them a water instead.
